answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 59 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is recorded against the copper challenge, the ridge audit can replay the anchor history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 733 identities would post 4297 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
